decisive_items: submucosal mass on the lesser curvature of the stomach
low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion
response.rationale: R2 is preferred over R1 due to the presence of a vascular signal, which is more commonly associated with GISTs than leiomyomas.

rejected.why: C1 is a subset of R2 and does not provide additional information.
